prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create a polished photorealistic LANDSCAPE 3:2 marketing scene for CheckBiz360 for EVENT PRODUCTION and AUDIOVISUAL EQUIPMENT RENTAL, using the supplied existing photo as the EDIT TARGET. Change ONLY the context from a building construction site to the setup of a professional audiovisual event inside a large venue. Preserve the foreground person's natural pose, hands and the entire smartphone with its existing visible CheckBiz360 'Tareas' screen, ALL its interface elements and Spanish labels exactly unchanged. That screen is the real product reference: no new cards, no renamed tasks, no new status labels, no invented screens. Replace the concrete construction backdrop by an event stage being assembled, black flight cases, aluminum lighting truss and neatly arranged sound equipment. Background crew with appropriate safety workwear, gently out of focus, no audience, no show in progress. Foreground worker wears a dark technical work polo with a high visibility vest and appropriate helmet for setup. The worker is stationary safely consulting the task list, not simultaneously handling equipment. Phone remains clear large and sharp at the right-center of image as in original; authentic calm work scene, natural venue lighting, navy and neutral tones, subtle warm practical lights. No building site, bricks, concrete building frame, cranes, hard sell text, ad banner, invented logo, certification badge, watermarks, price or overlay headline. Output a single standalone 1536x1024 image suitable for a landing page hero. Important: preserve the smartphone display content with extremely high fidelity; change environment and clothing only.

Use case: compositing. Edit the supplied existing photo into a photorealistic marketing scene for CheckBiz360 inside a professional AUDIOVISUAL EQUIPMENT RENTAL WAREHOUSE. This is a landing page asset about execution of work at the workplace. Preserve the complete foreground smartphone and the existing CheckBiz360 Tareas screen with extreme fidelity: keep the UI, task names Trabajo A/B/C, date controls, status chips, navigation and text exactly as supplied. Do not redesign the app or add invented warehouse-specific screen features. Keep natural hands holding the phone; worker stationary consulting tasks. Change the construction-site surroundings to an authentic tidy AV rental warehouse with shelving of black lighting fixtures, cable reels, flight cases ready for dispatch, an open foam-lined case on a preparation workbench, and a colleague preparing audiovisual equipment in the softly blurred background. Foreground person wears dark navy warehouse workwear, natural human features, no construction hard hat needed in this setting. Frame worker over shoulder left and sharp large smartphone right-center. Background must clearly communicate preparation of rental audiovisual equipment, not generic ecommerce boxes. Soft daylight from warehouse windows and neutral overhead lighting, navy/black/aluminum palette, candid premium editorial commercial photography, natural skin texture. No other brands, no slogans, no overlay text, no price, no scanner, no inventory counters. Single standalone LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 image. Screen is a supporting compositing input that must be preserved intact; only change environment and wardrobe.

Use case: compositing. Edit the supplied marketing photo for CheckBiz360 to show a worker viewing their working day IN AN EVENT VENUE, instead of at a building construction site. Preserve the entire foreground smartphone and the exact existing screen including Empresa demo, Control de Asistencia, JORNADA, DESCANSO, Centro A, Trabajador demo, time and task cards, all labels and controls unchanged. Preserve its large size, position, angle, hands and legibility. The output must demonstrate the current real CheckBiz360 working-day interface and must not invent a Rentman screen or imply proof of data synchronization. Replace building site, van construction tools and hard hat with an indoor event load-in area: black flight cases on a safe staging area, theatrical lighting truss, subtle stage curtains, a colleague sorting cables, a distant event stage being prepared. Foreground worker is in plain dark navy event-crew clothing with appropriate high visibility detailing. Person stands still safely checking their phone. Clean professional venue, realistic daytime working light with warm practical accents, premium candid editorial photography, detailed natural materials and natural skin. Do not add headlines, CTA, logos, price, legal/compliance badges or watermark. A single LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 scene, matching the visual quality and palette of a professional audiovisual event software campaign. Preserve ALL smartphone display content as the supplied product reference; change only setting and clothing.

Use case: compositing. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve the photoreal AV rental warehouse, person, hands, smartphone, camera angle and lighting. Image 2 is the exact real CheckBiz360 smartphone screen to INSERT instead of the task list currently on the phone in image 1. The user explicitly requests different app screens across creatives. Replace ONLY the phone screen in image 1 by image 2, perspective-matched, high fidelity and sharp. Keep the screen UI exactly: Detalle de tarea; EQUIPO with Trabajador and En curso; VALORACIONES with No hay valoraciones.; NOTAS with Agregar nota and Sin notas; RECURSOS with Adjuntar recurso and No hay recursos.; REVISIÓN FINAL with No hay validaciones.; original bottom navigation Tareas, Asistencia, Contacto and central existing logo. ONE mandatory anonymization: replace the real person's full name shown in image 2 with 'Técnico demo', and change avatar initial to T. Do not reproduce any personal name from screenshot. All other interface structure, controls, icons and labels must be unchanged; do not add mock functionality, invented validation, stock inventory, counters or success data. The phone must visibly show the detail screen and notes/evidence actions, NOT a task list. Single standalone LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 marketing photo, no captions or headline overlay. High product-screen fidelity is critical.

Use case: compositing. Edit this photo to become a CheckBiz360 marketing asset for AUDIOVISUAL EVENT CREW reporting an equipment issue IN THE EVENT VENUE. Preserve the entire phone, its placement and perspective, and its real CheckBiz360 Contacto/incidence screen exactly, with all labels and existing text: 'Contacto', 'Otro problema', 'Centro A', 'La máquina no arranca.', 'En revisión', 'Revisar', original bottom navigation. This screen is an exact product insert: no invented buttons, no task list, no new app UI. Replace the cleaning machine and mop trolley with a professional stage haze/fog machine in a black flight case next to an event equipment preparation table. Replace cleaning uniforms with plain navy event technical crew clothing. Keep the two natural adult workers collaborating while stationary: one holds the phone showing the issue; the other inspects the stage machine. Background: stage curtains, aluminum lighting truss and black audio flight cases, authentic working venue, no audience. Scene should clearly convey a field incident with context, not a staged office photo. Sharp legible phone foreground, natural hands and faces, soft lighting, navy/black/aluminum palette. No cleaning objects or cleaning signage. No new logos, captions, text overlays, safety badges or prices. Single standalone LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 image; preserve product screen contents with highest fidelity.

Use case: compositing. Adapt this existing CheckBiz360 backoffice marketing image for DIRECTION / OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT at an audiovisual event production and equipment rental company. Preserve the entire large computer monitor and the exact original CheckBiz360 'Gestión de tareas' backoffice interface, its existing logo, filters, task rows, Empresa demo, labels and navigation unchanged. This real product screen is the evidence; do not invent a Rentman interface, business charts, money values, new metrics or status labels. Preserve the two adult decision makers' natural poses: seated female operations director pointing to a task on the monitor, standing male production manager reviewing with her. Shift wardrobe to smart-casual professional operations clothing, no hard hats or construction PPE. Change the surrounding office to a glass-partitioned operations office overlooking an AV rental warehouse with flight cases, lighting fixtures and equipment shelves in soft focus, connecting management to the field operation. Remove construction blueprint rolls, hard hat on wall and the generic slogans from the reference background. Replace desk papers with a neutral notebook and a small unlabeled event venue floorplan, no legible private details. Contemporary professional environment, calm analytical discussion, daylight, navy and warm neutral tones. Computer screen should remain large and sharp occupying right half; humans occupy left. No headline, caption, price, overlay copy or third-party logos. Single standalone LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 image for the direction/supervision section of the landing. This scene communicates direction reviewing field tasks, not a task being approved or a completed automatic analysis.

Edit this marketing image with one precise correction. The phone displays a real incident report saying 'La máquina no arranca.' The fog machine must therefore look inactive: remove ALL smoke, fog, vapor, plume or haze coming from its front nozzle and around the equipment. Show a clear, unobstructed black inactive nozzle and clear air. Preserve every other aspect exactly: complete phone screen with all text unchanged, people, hands, stage, equipment, lighting and camera framing. Do not add any text, overlays, lights or other changes. Output 1536x1024.
